tasks.label: � LOCALHOST: Rebuild & Start All Containers
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔄 Rebuilding all containers with latest code...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; docker-compose down; docker-compose up -d --build; Write-Host '✅ Waiting for containers to start...' -ForegroundColor Green; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; docker ps; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '✅ Localhost is ready!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Frontend: http://localhost:80' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Backend: http://localhost:5000/api/health' -ForegroundColor Yellow

tasks.label: �🚀 Auto Commit & Push
tasks.command: .\quick-commit.ps1

tasks.label: 👀 Start Auto-Commit Watcher
tasks.command: .\auto-commit-watcher.ps1

tasks.label: 🏗️ Build Frontend
tasks.command: npm run build

tasks.label: 🚢 Deploy to Local Container
tasks.command: docker cp frontend/dist/. wms-frontend:/usr/share/nginx/html/ ; docker exec wms-frontend nginx -s reload

tasks.label: ✅ WORKFLOW STEP 1: Build & Test Locally
tasks.command: Write-Host '🧪 Building frontend locally...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd frontend; npm run build; if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '❌ Build failed! Fix errors before continuing.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } else { Write-Host '✅ Local build successful!' -ForegroundColor Green }

tasks.label: 📝 WORKFLOW STEP 2: Commit Changes Locally
tasks.command: .\quick-commit.ps1

tasks.label: 🚀 WORKFLOW STEP 3: Push to GitHub (Auto Triggers Staging)
tasks.command: Write-Host '📤 Pushing to GitHub...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; git push origin stable/prisma-mysql-production; Write-Host '✅ Pushed! GitHub Actions will deploy to staging automatically.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '🔗 Watch progress: https://github.com/Akifbade/wms/actions' -ForegroundColor Yellow

tasks.label: 🧪 WORKFLOW STEP 4: Test on Staging (148.230.107.155:8080)
tasks.command: Write-Host '✅ Testing staging deployment...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; `$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://148.230.107.155:8080/api/health' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (`$response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host '🟢 STAGING HEALTHY - Ready for testing!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '🌐 Open browser: http://148.230.107.155:8080' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Start-Process 'http://148.230.107.155:8080' } else { Write-Host '🔴 Staging not ready yet. GitHub Actions might still be deploying. Wait 2-5 minutes.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🟢 WORKFLOW STEP 5: Approve Production Deployment
tasks.command: Write-Host '✅ Staging is good!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '📋 TO DEPLOY TO PRODUCTION:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '1. Go to: https://github.com/Akifbade/wms/actions' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '2. Click: Three-Stage Deployment workflow' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '3. Click: Run workflow' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '4. Select environment: production' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '5. Click: Run workflow' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '6. GitHub will ask for approval - click Approve' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '✅ Then production will update automatically!' -ForegroundColor Green; Start-Process 'https://github.com/Akifbade/wms/actions'

tasks.label: ⚡ QUICK WORKFLOW: Local → Staging → Production
tasks.command: Write-Host '═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '⚡ COMPLETE WORKFLOW (DO IN THIS ORDER)' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Step 1: Make code changes locally' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Step 2: Run Task → WORKFLOW STEP 1: Build & Test Locally' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'Step 3: Run Task → WORKFLOW STEP 2: Commit Changes Locally' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'Step 4: Run Task → WORKFLOW STEP 3: Push to GitHub' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'Step 5: Wait 3-5 minutes for GitHub Actions' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host 'Step 6: Run Task → WORKFLOW STEP 4: Test on Staging' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'Step 7: Test features on http://148.230.107.155:8080' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Step 8: If staging OK, Run Task → WORKFLOW STEP 5: Approve Production' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '✅ That is it! No manual VPS work needed.' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: 🔒 SAFETY: Verify Staging Before Production
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔍 Checking staging health...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; `$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://148.230.107.155:8080/api/health' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (`$response.StatusCode -eq 200) { `$data = `$response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host '✅ STAGING HEALTHY' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Version: ' + `$data.version) -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Environment: ' + `$data.environment) -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '🟢 SAFE TO PROMOTE TO PRODUCTION' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ STAGING HEALTH CHECK FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'DO NOT promote to production!' -ForegroundColor Red }

tasks.label: 🔒 SAFETY: Verify Production Health
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔍 Checking production health...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; `$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://148.230.107.155/api/health' -SkipCertificateCheck -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (`$response.StatusCode -eq 200) { `$data = `$response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host '✅ PRODUCTION HEALTHY' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Version: ' + `$data.version) -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Environment: ' + `$data.environment) -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ Production health check failed' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🔄 LOCALHOST REBUILD: Fresh Docker Build
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔨 Rebuilding localhost Docker containers with LATEST CODE...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd .; docker-compose down --remove-orphans 2>&1 | Out-Null; docker-compose up --build -d 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/health' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Content | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "✅ Localhost backend running v$($_.version)" -ForegroundColor Green }

tasks.label: 📱 LOCALHOST TEST: Open Frontend
tasks.command: Start-Process 'http://localhost'; Write-Host '✅ Frontend opened at http://localhost' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: 🧪 LOCALHOST TEST: Check All APIs
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔍 Testing localhost APIs...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; `$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/health' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (`$response.StatusCode -eq 200) { `$data = `$response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host '✅ Backend: ' + `$data.version -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '✅ QR Format: SHIPMENT_XXX and RACK_XXX (simplified)' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '✅ Pallet QR: REMOVED from UI' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Backend API not responding' -ForegroundColor Red }

tasks.label: 🔄 AUTO-RELOAD: Watch Localhost Changes
tasks.command: .\watch-localhost.ps1

tasks.label: ⚡ QUICK: Rebuild Localhost After Changes
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔨 Rebuilding localhost...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd frontend; npm run build; cd ..; docker cp frontend/dist/. wms-frontend:/usr/share/nginx/html/; docker exec wms-frontend nginx -s reload; docker-compose restart wms-backend; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/health' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Content | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "✅ Localhost updated: v$($_.version)" -ForegroundColor Green }

tasks.label: 💾 Create Complete Plug-and-Play Backup
tasks.command: $timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss'; $backupName = "WMS_FULL_SYSTEM_$timestamp"; $backupPath = "C:\WMS_FULL_BACKUPS\$backupName"; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '================================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ' WMS COMPLETE PLUG-AND-PLAY SYSTEM BACKUP' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '================================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host "Creating: $backupName" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$backupPath\database" -Force | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$backupPath\backend" -Force | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$backupPath\frontend" -Force | Out-Null; Write-Host '[1/5] Backing up database...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; docker exec wms-database mysqldump -u wms_user -pwmspassword123 --single-transaction --routines --triggers warehouse_wms 2>$null > "$backupPath\database\database.sql"; Write-Host '  Database backed up' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[2/5] Backing up backend source...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Copy-Item -Path 'backend\*' -Destination "$backupPath\backend\" -Recurse -Exclude @('node_modules','dist','uploads') -Force; Write-Host '  Backend source backed up' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[3/5] Backing up uploads...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path 'backend\uploads') { Copy-Item -Path 'backend\uploads' -Destination "$backupPath\backend\" -Recurse -Force; Write-Host '  Uploads backed up' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '  No uploads folder' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host '[4/5] Backing up frontend source...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Copy-Item -Path 'frontend\*' -Destination "$backupPath\frontend\" -Recurse -Exclude @('node_modules','dist') -Force; Write-Host '  Frontend source backed up' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[5/5] Backing up configs...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Copy-Item -Path 'docker-compose*.yml' -Destination $backupPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Path '.env*' -Destination $backupPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '  Configs backed up' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Compressing to ZIP...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Compress-Archive -Path "$backupPath\*" -DestinationPath "$backupPath.zip" -CompressionLevel Optimal -Force; Remove-Item -Path $backupPath -Recurse -Force; $size = [math]::Round((Get-Item "$backupPath.zip").Length / 1MB, 2); Write-Host ''; Write-Host '================================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ' COMPLETE BACKUP CREATED SUCCESSFULLY!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '================================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host "Location: $backupPath.zip" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Size: $size MB" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'This backup includes:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  - Complete backend + frontend source code' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  - Full database with all data' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  - All uploads and user files' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  - Docker configurations' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'To restore: Extract ZIP and run docker-compose up -d --build' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''

tasks.label: 🔢 AUTO-VERSION: Increment Version Number
tasks.command: .vscode\auto-version.ps1

tasks.label: 🚀 AUTO-VERSION: Build & Deploy (Quick)
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔢 Auto-incrementing version...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; .vscode\auto-version.ps1; Write-Host '🔨 Building frontend...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd frontend; npm run build; cd ..; Write-Host '📦 Deploying to Docker...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; docker cp frontend/dist/. wms-frontend:/usr/share/nginx/html/; docker exec wms-frontend nginx -s reload; Write-Host '✅ Deploy complete! Press Ctrl+Shift+R in browser to see changes.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; (Get-Content frontend/src/config/version.ts | Select-String 'APP_VERSION') -replace ".*'(.*)'.*", 'New version: $1' | Write-Host -ForegroundColor Yellow

tasks.label: 🔄 AUTO-VERSION: Rebuild Docker (Full)
tasks.command: Write-Host '🔢 Auto-incrementing version...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; .vscode\auto-version.ps1; Write-Host '🔨 Rebuilding Docker container...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; docker-compose build --no-cache frontend; docker-compose up -d frontend; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; Write-Host '✅ Full rebuild complete! Press Ctrl+Shift+R in browser.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; (Get-Content frontend/src/config/version.ts | Select-String 'APP_VERSION') -replace ".*'(.*)'.*", 'New version: $1' | Write-Host -ForegroundColor Yellow
